free_tier.stated: No free plan. Starter is USD 299 a month billed yearly with a 14-day free trial and no credit card, and it runs one managed cluster in the customer's own cloud, so the compute is a separate invoice from AWS, GCP or Azure.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: none for a zero-budget start: 14 days of a control plane over a cloud account that must already exist.
record.limits_note: there is no allowance to bind: the platform floor is USD 299 a month and the instances are billed by the cloud account it manages.

identity_cost.detail: no card for the trial: the pricing page states 'Starter USD 299 per month billed yearly with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required'. No hold exists on the trial because no payment method is taken. The signup fields are not quoted, so the email requirement is inferred rather than read; a card enters only when Starter is bought, and debit and prepaid acceptance are not stated.

evidence.proved: Starter USD 299 per month billed yearly with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required; 1 managed cluster on your own cloud; 3,000 minutes of deployment per month, quoted
Growth USD 899 per month with 2 managed clusters; the page describes the product as running in the customer's cloud account, quoted

record.notes: Qovery cloud deployment platform starts at USD 299 monthly with a 14-day trial period. Cloud infrastructure costs bill directly to the user's cloud provider account.
